decision_reason: Precise source-matched formulation, independent specialist status, resolution/scope checks, completed baseline duplicate review and separated adversarial self-pass passed. Await first-batch refresh and integration.

problem_fingerprint.model_or_objects: Finite connected undirected graph G=(V,E), capacities c_e >= 0, k independent unicast messages with specified pairs (s_i,t_i)
problem_fingerprint.dimension: Arbitrary finite graph and finite k
problem_fingerprint.domain: All such graphs, capacities and source-destination pairs, s_i != t_i
problem_fingerprint.regularity_and_data_class: Noiseless links; independent messages; arbitrary nonlinear causal coding allowed
problem_fingerprint.boundary_or_initial_conditions: Initially each source knows its own message; each sink requests that message alone
problem_fingerprint.parameter_range: All nonnegative rate vectors r; terminal locations may coincide across sessions
problem_fingerprint.quantifiers: For every G,c and session collection, every achievable coding rate vector is fractionally routable
problem_fingerprint.normalization: Sum of both directional communication rates on an undirected edge is at most c_e
problem_fingerprint.limit_regime_and_order: Closure over finite block codes and common packet/block scaling; no bound on completion latency
problem_fingerprint.computational_model_and_dependencies: Unrestricted local computation, deterministic causal coding, arbitrary packet splitting for routing; no linear-code restriction

statement_source_and_scope_match: LL §3.2 Proposition 3.1 is explicitly conjectural despite its proposition label. LQLL §III Conjecture 1 restates the capacity-region equality; cost-domain equivalents count as one problem.
proposed_statement_text: For every finite undirected capacitated graph and finite collection of independent unicast sessions, is the zero-error network-coding throughput region equal to the fractional multicommodity-flow region, with both directions sharing each edge capacity?
applied_significance: Determines whether mixing independent data streams at routers can increase sustained transmission rates over optimal fractional packet routing in bidirectional networks.

closest_existing_or_new_entries.difference: Binary multiplying two-way channel has a fixed noisy/interactive channel law; no arbitrary noiseless network comparison.
Gaussian relay channel concerns a different noisy three-node capacity question.
Binary deletion channel is a single stochastic channel.
Cycle-graph Shannon capacity is a zero-error confusability product problem, not network routing.
Two-party deterministic communication versus matrix rank, not a network throughput region.

duplicate_review.distinctness_reason: No baseline statement or accepted draft asserts coding/routing equality for all undirected independent-unicast networks.
implications_or_equivalences: Cost-domain inequality and throughput-domain equality are one canonical conjecture. Restricted graph subcases are not counted separately.

open_status_evidence_summary: LQLL August 2026 explicitly retains the general conjecture; independent BH October 2025 distinguishes its multicast separation from the unresolved unicast problem.
independent_status_corroboration: Braverman and He have no authors in common with the original Li–Li paper or LQLL. HWZ also independently distinguishes completion-time gains from unicast throughput.
strongest_known_partial_results_and_gap: LQLL covers at most five terminal locations, designated-face planar cases, restricted demand graphs and at most six coding nodes. General undirected networks remain outside those theorems.

issues_found: Edge directions must share one budget.
Independent unicast differs from multicast copies of the same message.
Exact recovery and asymptotic throughput must be distinguished from epsilon-error and completion-time models.
2026 interaction theorem is an equivalence, not a universal proof.
2014 note by Yang et al. located at metadata level only; no full-resolution claim located, and later independent BH plus LQLL still explicitly leave the general conjecture open.
issues_resolved: Draft defines shared capacities, arbitrary causal nonlinear codes, asymptotic packet scaling and fractional routing.
Full statements of all located apparent recent resolution results were compared. Cost and throughput equivalents counted once.
